statement.en: forall emp, (forall x, not (x in emp)) -> not (emp in emp)
statement.ja: すべての emp について (すべての x について x が emp に属さない) ならば emp は emp に属さない

script:
theorem specialize_example : forall emp, (forall x, not (x in emp)) -> not (emp in emp).
intro emp.
intro H.
specialize H emp as H1.
exact H1.
qed.

explanation.en: In this lesson, we learn how to specialize a hypothesis. First, proceed with the proof as we have done so far.
explanation.ja: 今回は仮定の特殊化について学びます．まず，今までの方法で証明を進めてみましょう．

progress.en: We know how to handle a goal of the form P -> Q from the previous lesson.
progress.ja: P -> Q の形のゴールの進め方は前回やった通りです．

progress.en:
The hypothesis now contains forall x, not (x in emp), while the conclusion has the form obtained by substituting emp for this x. To specialize the x in a hypothesis H : forall x, P(x) to a concrete value c and obtain a new hypothesis H1, use

specialize H c as H1.

Use this tactic.
progress.ja:
仮定に forall x, not (x in emp) が現れ，結論はこの x に emp を代入したような形になっています．仮定 H : forall x, P(x) の x を具体的な値 c に特殊化して新しい仮定 H1 を得るには，

specialize H c as H1.

を使います．
